claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for UTxO RPC maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.

The maintenance budget is described as funding a part-time UTxO RPC maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD, with 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve stated in the motivation section.
UTxO RPC is presented as an open interface specification for UTxO-based blockchains using Protocol Buffers and SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python.
The proposer claims UTxO RPC has been adopted by Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node as a query interface, validating it as a Cardano ecosystem standard.
The project is said to maintain more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, language SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations under the Apache 2.0 open-source license.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and includes references to voting records, documentation, final audited results, and an audit report.
The proposer states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission, either alone or in aggregate.

Audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are described as being provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with administration costs included in the proposal overhead.

TxPipe is reported to have received 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, plus 2025 Intersect maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC delivered on schedule.

Intersect plans to administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with listed TRSC and PSSC addresses, specified multi-party authorization thresholds, an Oversight Committee, and a public dashboard for auditability.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of UTxO RPC maintenance by TxPipe, routed through Intersect-managed treasury smart contracts with stated oversight, NCL compliance, and Intersect budget-process support.
